title: Priority-preserving projected resource allocation: reproducibility package

creators.name: Bezoui, Madani
creators.affiliation: CESI LINEACT (UR 7527), Campus de Nancy, France

description: Reproducible experimental software, provenance manifests and numerical outputs for single-resource priority-preserving projected allocation. Includes historical trace replays, synthetic scenarios, bounded-error and ramp diagnostics, numerical checks, and post-review fairness and paired timing analyses. Software is licensed under MIT. Original results and documentation are separately licensed CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA.md). Upstream UCI data attribution is retained in DATA_SOURCES.md. Manuscript sources, bibliography, templates, editorial files and manuscript PDF are excluded. This is a counterfactual allocation study, not a deployment validation.
